paper_level_summary_zh: 本文利用[23]（ADNS-3050光学鼠标传感器数据手册）的像素抓取寄存器技术细节，将光学鼠标改造成高速相机，实现声学窃听。

evidences.evidence_quote: the ADNS-3050 [23], include a special register called the ‘pixel grabber’.
evidences.evidence_context: Upon reviewing technical datasheets, we made an unexpected discovery: mainstream optical sensors used in optical mice, such as the ADNS-3050 [23], include a special register called the ‘pixel grabber’.
evidences.reference_entry: A. Technologies, “Adns-3050 optical mouse sensor datasheet,” https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/678/avagotechnologies ADNS-3050-1217285.pdf.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: [23]是数据手册，非目标论文；引用仅涉及传感器寄存器，不涉及目标论文的RFID窃听方案。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
